notes: Registry for tests/fixtures/repairs. Entries are either state=present (the file exists here and sha256 is its hash) or state=absent (not created in this pass: sha256 is null and absence_reason says why).
A hash is never invented for a file this repository does not hold, and no real credential, capture, or provider body is stored here.
All synthetic fixtures use Acme/Rival tiles data on .example or .invalid hosts.

required_test_files.note: The R21 cases the runner owns. Collected by src/lib/repairs/*.test.mjs, so the runner can dispatch it.
Public website foundation: canonicals, sitemap, robots, host policy, and marketing claims.
